title: DI String Match
description: Given a string s of 'I' (increase) and 'D' (decrease), return a permutation of [0...n] that satisfies the string constraints.

steps.note: Initialize pointers low = 0 and high = 4 for string length 4
Input is 'I', push low (0) and increment low
Input is 'D', push high (4) and decrement high
Input is 'I', push low (1) and increment low
Input is 'D', push high (3) and decrement high
